description: A strip marker removes a carriage return that is not followed by a line feed
notes: The spec says strip markers remove spaces, "interpreted as per Unicode's definition", without saying which definition it means. The carriage return U+000D has the White_Space property but is not a space separator (category Zs). Stripping it is hashicorp/hcl's reading: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go trims with Go's unicode.IsSpace, which follows the White_Space property. The spec also doesn't say whether escape sequences are decoded before stripping; hashicorp/hcl decodes them first, calling ParseStringLiteralToken before it trims.
